{{Top|leg}}
A '''long knife''' was a type of traditional weapon used by various species and beings throughout the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. The long knife was a long version of a [[Knife/Legends|knife]], shorter than a [[Sword/Legends|sword]], and used almost exclusively as a close-quarters [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapon]].

The [[Alwari]] nomads of [[Ansion/Legends|Ansion]] bore long knives through many generations before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

[[Chay Praysh]]'s [[Drach'nam]] guards used long knives in [[Praysh's fortress|his palace]]. The knife sported a hilt with spikes on it, but it was ineffective against [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]]. As the guards did not have [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblades]], they carried with their long knives [[Neuronic whip/Legends|neuronic whips]].
